title: Fig's Little Bridge
note: b417 — Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations ie as ee, ea as e, ou as oo.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar stopping at the edge of a small gap in the path, a pond on one side.
A clear view of the gap, too wide for Fig to cross in one hop.
Fig the caterpillar looking around at twigs, leaves and a flat shell scattered near the pond.
Fig the caterpillar spotting a long, flat twig resting in the grass.
Fig the caterpillar laying the twig carefully across the gap, forming a little bridge.
The twig bridge wobbling slightly as Fig tests it with one foot.
Fig the caterpillar wedging a flat shell underneath the middle of the twig bridge for support.
The twig bridge now steady and still, propped firmly by the shell.
Fig the caterpillar slowly crawling across the twig bridge over the gap.
Fig the caterpillar standing happily on the far side of the gap, the little bridge behind it.
